messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: auth-proxy service (auth-proxy-1) is reporting an unusual burst of 401/403s and request header anomalies. See alert: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/1234

priya: I'm on call. grabbing logs and tracing from the proxy. any customer-facing errors?

maria: i'm pulling recent access logs (last 10m) — seeing repeated header patterns: `X-Client-Id: svc-` with low-entropy suffixes, and frequent `Authorization: Bearer` failures. sample snippet:```
[2026-05-12T14:12:03Z] src=10.200.45.12 method=POST path=/v1/generate code=401 auth_err=invalid_token token_id=svc-aaaa1111
[2026-05-12T14:12:04Z] src=35.198.77.9 method=POST path=/v1/generate code=401 auth_err=invalid_token token_id=svc-aaaa2222
```

darren: could be token spray against our hosted endpoints. is it isolated to one region?

maria: mostly us-west-2 and a handful of IPs from eu-west-1. traffic pattern looks automated, rapid bursts, ~3k req/min for 5m then drop.

liz: any signs of leaked tokens or logs containing tokens? we had that S3 debug bucket exposure last quarter — want to rule that out before broad rotation.

maria: quick grep of recent debug-logs index shows a handful of debug entries that contain a prefix `svc-` and partial token fragments (not full BEARER string) — looks like truncated debug output from a staging worker. sample redacted:```
... session_start token_prefix=svc-aaaa... user=svc-monitor
```

security: we should assume partial exposure. start containment: rotate the suspect service tokens, block the abusive IPs at the loadbalancer, and create an incident ticket. I want preserved logs for forensics.

priya: agreed. taking the first containment steps now. blocking top 20 abusive IPs via waf rule. applying temporary rate-limit policy on /v1/* for anonymous tokens.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-1789 and key-rotation task TASK-5467 (assignee: darren).

darren: will queue a targeted secret rotation for service tokens with prefix patterns `svc-aaaa*` and `svc-aaaa2*`. plan: rotate, push new secrets to dedicated vault path, and rollout to proxy pool-canary nodes first. ETA 20m for canary.

priya: can we do a narrow kill of sessions rather than global rotate? we can revoke sessions tied to the prefix if token store has token metadata.

maria: token store has metadata for token_id prefix mapping for ~60% of those tokens. will export list and hand to darren. saving full query results to S3 audit path (restricted) and marking as forensic evidence.

security: do not upload evidence to public buckets. use the forensics-only KMS and the secure S3 path /forensics/inc-2026-1789. confirm ACLs.

maria: confirmed, uploaded to s3://forensics/inc-2026-1789/logs-20260512.gz (server-side-encryption=AES256).

darren: starting targeted rotate now. rotation script snippet I'm running:```bash
for t in $(cat tokens-to-rotate.txt); do rotate-token --id $t --vault-path secret/service-tokens/rotations; sleep 0.5; done
```

priya: canary passed smoke tests against new tokens on two proxy nodes. issuing rolling restart to remaining pool with 10% step. monitoring error budget.

liz: customer impact check: support dashboard shows 8 customers with elevated 401s in last 15m; opening customer comms draft.

security: we should prepare a minimal customer-facing note: acknowledge increased auth errors, mitigation underway, no evidence of customer data exfil at this time. I'll review the draft.

maria: post-rotate log tail shows the spray stopped after rotation started. residual 401s are legitimate failed attempts from older client versions.

darren: rotation complete for flagged tokens. revocation status: 142/142 rotated, 0 failures. rolling token caches expired within 90s.

priya: removing temporary WAF blocklist slowly to avoid letting any leftover attacker requests back in while caches clear.

ops-bot: Updated ticket INC-2026-1789: containment complete, mitigation in progress, forensics collected, postmortem assigned to priya and security.

security: handing incident to oncall-investigations for root cause analysis. priya — please take postmortem and include: how token fragments reached logs, why staging debug logs hit prod index (indexing pipeline ACLs), and recommended guardrails.

priya: taking PM. i'll do timeline + RCA and tag eng-infra and devex for follow-ups. handing over the live thread to investigations team. i'm off at 17:00 PST but will be available on pager for 30m.

liz: thanks team. keeping customer comms on hold until security signs off. letting support know the rotation happened and we're monitoring. :white_check_mark:
